<!-- pr-reviewer: 3842338cb7841e23f1ffc3610fad2a07dee8976f -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The review found no blocking items.

- The document and setup pages use the existing undoable post-options command.
- The tests check the checkbox role, label, state, undo, redo, and setup isolation.
- The PR body has before and after images for both pages.
- The existing MCP tools and skill entries cover Explain. The added test checks the named setup.

Local checks against upstream/main at `31f8d03d744e77ce707282d816e11efe0922f239`:

- The trial merge was clean. Main was already an ancestor of this head.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. Both steps passed. The UI library had 849 passes and 6 ignored tests. The six UI integration suites had 29 passes. The named-setup MCP test passed.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app --test mcp_post_options`: PASS, 5 tests.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.

This is a safety-tier review because the switch can change posted comments. I ran two of the stated mutations in the local review worktree:

1. Remove the Explain control call from `pages.rs`: both new tests failed because the checkbox was absent. Restore the call: both passed.
2. Do not queue the Explain command: both new tests failed because the checkbox stayed off after the click. Restore the command: both passed.

All temporary changes were restored. No G-code, CL, or image golden changed. There were no moved golden lines to check. The original G21 fixture checks comment output and unchanged executable text. It does not check a full machining program. No machine run or native window test was done.

Requested before merge: none.

Nonblocking note: `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs` grows by one line to 1,260 lines. A later change can move the post section to its own module.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
